derivation: An earlier renewal was withheld and appended one proposal record with disposition WITHHELD under LIFE-007, leaving the prior permit unsuperseded. The current renewal is eligible and every check succeeds, so it appends one PERMITTED proposal record and creates one permit. LIFE-019 states that a permit renewal increments neither the activation nor the actuation counter and that actuations increment only when an occurrence's initial proposal becomes PERMITTED, so per-step and total counters are unchanged and consumption against maximum_actuations does not move. The decision receipt sequence advances by one because every admitted transition appends exactly one receipt.
